name: Support desk
description: Routes a customer message to the billing and tech specialists, merges their answers into one reply, and has a reviewer check the reply before it goes out.

billing.description: Answers invoice, duplicate charge and refund questions. Receives a self-contained task as one user message.

tech.description: Answers questions about errors, outages and bugs. Receives a self-contained task as one user message.

desk.description: Routes the customer message to the specialists and writes the reply from their answers.

review.description: Checks the reply against the review rubric.
